name: Tuvalu
governmentType: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

profile.religions: Protestant 92.7% (Congregational Christian Church of Tuvalu 85.9%, Brethren 2.8%, Seventh Day Adventist 2.5%, Assemblies of God 1.5%), Baha'i 1.5%, Jehovah's Witness 1.5%, other 3.9%, none or refused 0.4% (2017 est.)
profile.legalSystem: mixed system of English common law and local customary law
profile.location: Oceania, island group consisting of nine coral atolls in the South Pacific Ocean, about half way from Hawaii to Australia
profile.currencyText: Tuvaluan dollars or Australian dollars (AUD) per US dollar -
